column1: # Game profile of NINJA GAIDEN Σ (Switch, update 1.0.2 = v131072 over the base game). Mac-tested through Chapter 1 gameplay
# Team Ninja's engine on SDK 10.9.0, NVN. Modules main, subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) and sdk.
# Shader programs are GLSLC outputs in indexed zlib databin / patchbin archives and main; shader_split.py reads the archive entries.
# The app name and bundle ID come from the base game's control data and title ID.
# main imports from these modules; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# No system resource: the game uses the 4 GB address-space layout and sets a heap from the app pool.
# The rewritten modules require more than the default 64 MB reported as used memory.
